info.name: Sonatype Lifecycle Public REST Advanced Search License Overrides API

params.name: ownerType
params.description: Select the `ownerType` for which you want to retrieve the applied license overrides.

params.name: ownerId
params.description: Enter the id of the application, organization or the repository.

params.name: componentIdentifier
params.description: Enter the componentIdentifier consisting of format and coordinates as a JSON e.g., `?componentIdentifier={"format":"maven","coordinates":"{...}}"}

items.docs:
Use this method to retrieve the applied license overrides for a component.

Permissions required: View IQ Elements

params.name: ownerType
params.description: Select the `ownerType` scope for which you want to add or update a license override

params.name: ownerId
params.description: Enter the id of the application, organization or the repository.

items.docs:
Use this method to add or update a license override to a component for a given owner scope.

Permissions required: Change Licenses

params.name: ownerType
params.description: Select the `ownerType` for which you want to retrieve the applied license overrides.

params.name: ownerId
params.description: Enter the id of the owner.

params.name: componentIdentifier
params.description: Enter the component format and coordinates.

items.docs:
Use this method to retrieve the applied license overrides for a given component and owner.

Permissions required: Review Legal Obligations For Components Licenses

params.name: ownerType
params.description: Select the `ownerType` scope for which you want to delete license override

params.name: ownerId
params.description: Enter the id of the application, organization or the repository.

params.name: licenseOverrideId
params.description: Enter the id of the license override you want to delete.

items.docs:
Use this method to delete a license override for a component.

Permissions required: Change Licenses
